writeup.title: feat(reviews): add review moderation and flagging system
writeup.summary: This branch introduces a moderation system for customer reviews, allowing users to flag reviews with valid reasons. When a review receives three flags, its status updates to hidden, removing it from public product pages and ratings while allowing administrators to review hidden entries via a dedicated endpoint.
changes: Added a review_flags table and a review status column via database migration 0004.
Added POST /reviews/<id>/flag endpoint allowing authenticated customers to flag reviews with specific reasons.
Added GET /reviews/hidden endpoint for administrators to list reviews hidden by flags.
Updated review queries and rating summary computations to exclude hidden reviews.
Added comprehensive unit tests covering flagging rules, hidden review limits, and role access.

functions.what_it_does: Flags a specific review with a provided reason after validating its existence.
Returns a paginated list of hidden reviews for authenticated administrators.
Returns a query for published reviews of a product ordered by newest first.
Calculates the total count and rounded average rating for published reviews of a product.
Records a user flag on a review and hides the review if the flag threshold is reached.
Returns a query for hidden reviews ordered by ID in ascending order.
Placeholder function for scoring review text that is not yet implemented.

writeup.release_note: Customers can flag reviews (POST /reviews/<id>/flag). Three flags hide a review; admins list hidden reviews at GET /reviews/hidden.
